recognize_zh: 低倍脾臟切片可見紅髓瀰漫性被密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤，失去正常紅髓白髓分界，另有數個淡灰藍、細胞稀少的無定形區；需結合臨床（傳染性單核球增多症、脾破裂）與高倍、免疫染色才能判讀。
features: Diffusely hypercellular parenchyma with loss of the normal white pulp/red pulp demarcation
Dense infiltrate of small dark nuclei throughout the red pulp
Several pale gray-blue, hypocellular amorphous zones (possible edema, fibrin or hemorrhage; not resolvable at this power)
Thin linear clefts, likely sectioning artifact
Cytologic detail (immunoblasts) cannot be assessed at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of spleen shows diffusely hypercellular parenchyma with effacement of the usual white pulp/red pulp distinction by a dense lymphoid infiltrate. Several pale, hypocellular amorphous areas are present, which may represent edema, fibrin deposition or hemorrhage but cannot be characterized at this magnification. Individual cell morphology, including immunoblasts, is not assessable. In the appropriate clinical setting these findings are consistent with the red pulp expansion of infectious mononucleosis predisposing to splenic rupture, but they are not specific on their own.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving spleen
ddx.vs: DLBCL typically forms destructive nodular masses of monotonous large B cells, whereas infectious mononucleosis shows a polymorphous T-cell-rich infiltrate with scattered EBER-positive immunoblasts.
HSTCL shows sinusoidal infiltration by monotonous medium-sized gamma-delta T cells with atrophic white pulp, rather than a polymorphous reactive infiltrate.
Congestive spleen shows dilated sinusoids with fibrosis of cords and little lymphoid infiltrate.
